doc.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

title: Opening and introductions
summary: Monk Rowe opens the interview; Ross describes herself as singer, writer, lyricist and author.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are in New York City filming for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. I’m extremely pleased to have Annie Ross with me this evening.
Well I appreciate it so much. You are an actress and a vocalist and you’ve been on numerous continents working.
I’m a singer, I’m a writer, I’m a lyricist, I’m an author.
